name: Kandahar 2
kurzbeschreibung: **Welcome to Kandahar 2 in Tirol – your ultimate adventure playground!** Nestled in the heart of the **Tirol** Alps, just a stone’s throw from **Innsbruck**, **Kandahar 2** is the world’s largest **indoor** snow park, offering **365 days of winter fun**—rain or shine! Whether you're a seasoned snowboarder or a first-timer, this **high-tech** paradise delivers **thrilling slopes, expert coaching, and a vibrant après-ski scene**. **Snowboarding & Skiing for All Levels** Dive into **Tirol’s** legendary snow culture with **12,000 m² of perfectly groomed slopes**, including **halfpipe, big air, and freestyle zones**. The **Kandahar 2** team ensures **top-notch training** for beginners and **pro-level tricks** for experts. **Lessons for kids, teens, and adults**—because every rider deserves to shred! **Beyond the Slopes: Food, Fun & Relaxation** After burning off energy, recharge with **Tirol’s** finest **Kaiserschmarrn**, hearty **Käsespätzle**, or a **Schnaps** at the **cozy mountain lodge**. The **rooftop terrace** offers **panoramic views** of the **Nordkette**, while the **arcade and chill zones** keep the party going. **Events & Competitions** From **snowboard contests** to **family fun days**, **Kandahar 2** hosts **year-round events** that bring the **Tirol** community together. Check the schedule for **exclusive workshops, DJ nights, and pro demos**—adventure never sleeps! **Your Gateway to Tirol’s Outdoor Paradise** Just **15 minutes from Innsbruck**, **Kandahar 2** is your **hub for alpine adventures**. Hit the **pistes of Nordkette** or **Ahornbahn** afterward, or explore **Tirol’s** charming villages like **St. Anton** or **Mayrhofen**. With **free parking, lockers, and rental gear**, everything’s covered—so you can focus on the **fun**. **Book Now & Ride All Year!** Whether you're chasing **snowboard gold** or just **soaking up Tirol’s** winter vibes, **Kandahar 2** is your **24/7 playground**. **Reserve your session today** and let the **Alpine magic** take over! --- **Visit Kandahar 2 | Book Online | Follow Us**
